# MOG-20261109-049 原片3 帧时钟与装饰标题

同源历史版本遇到源毫秒时间戳与编码帧时钟的核验失败。复做时保留两种实际时间基准，按现行取证合同核对映射和硬性校验。

原片红色点状标题包含白、蓝、黄轮廓和快速缩放、径向切换，历史实际字体及图层仅近似这些表现。约3.6秒切换应核对相邻实际帧。小字修复也曾柔化地板和脚边纹理。

西语、日语、巴西葡语历史成片为完整六句配音的 best-available 结果。各语种具体字形差异、ASR分歧及质量限制见 evidence:observations。原取证门禁结果及正常速度视听缺口保留。

adopted_parts: For this source, preserve millisecond source timestamps and exact encoded frame-clock evidence separately. retained_parts: Source rounded decorative face, stipple and outline thickness are approximated with real Arial Rounded glyphs and layered PNG; title is uppercase and challenge spans wider than original.
Original rapid first-title scale is reconstructed; radial-blur transition is simplified to a switch at3.6s. Actual sampled 3.5667/3.6/3.6667 frames confirm source title event order.
Tiny watermark glyph repair softens floor/feet texture locally; sampled three-column frames retain subject, hat, room and rear-view movement with no severe damage observed.

Real encoded full/head/tail no-VAD Spanish ASR recognizes all six translated turns including initial La and final Espera. ASR cannot prove zero residual English, voice naturalness or music fidelity; no direct listening or continuous normal-speed visual playback claimed.
Complete dubbed best-available output; quality not approved and no independent or user/company acceptance claimed.
Original outcome, source evidence, actual video hashes and any fee information are retained in the evidence bundle.
